error.description: What went wrong and what to do next.

code.description: `usage` for a malformed command line (exit 2), a reason such as `no-quota-source` or `alias-invalid`, or `error`.

reason.description: Same as `code`, for a refused Task Spec (`sideby ask --spec -`): `spec-invalid`, `spec-too-large`, `bad-cwd`, or `spec-version` (exit 2: update sideby).

operationId.description: Only from `sideby quota reset`: the operation this failure belongs to. With `code: outcome-unknown` the Host gave no final answer; run `sideby quota reset <account> --yes --operation <operationId>` to ask again with the same request, which cannot use a second limit reset. With `code: outcome-not-saved` the Host answered (`error` says what) but sideby could not record it; run the same command once the file `error` names can be written.

command.description: Run it after the user agrees: it shows the plan and exits 10; then --yes.

installed.description: The skill's version; null when it has none.

command.description: `sideby update`, which updates the skill with sideby: run it after the user agrees; it shows the plan and exits 10, then --yes.

_notice.description: Not the answer to the task: mention it briefly afterwards and offer to update.
